DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展望施設のご利用について、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with using the observation facility?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 函館の景色を見たいんですが、膝が痛むので長い階段は避けたいです。展望場所へ行く方法を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 膝が痛むので長い階段を避けたいと説明し、展望場所へ行く方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to see the views of Hakodate, but my knees hurt, so I want to avoid long stairways. Can I choose how to get to the viewing area?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your knees hurt and you want to avoid long stairways, and ask about ways to reach the viewing area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用できる経路を現地の案内で確認しましょう。上りだけでなく、帰りも階段を避けたいということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the routes available in the on-site information. You want to avoid stairs on the way back as well as on the way up, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、下りも不安です。同行者は先に上へ行ったので、別の経路なら合流できる場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りの階段も不安だと伝え、先に上がった同行者と合流できる場所を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I am worried about going down too. My companion has already gone up ahead, so if I take another route, I want to check where we can meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are worried about the stairs on the return journey too, and want to check where to meet your companion who has already gone up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 往復に使える経路を確認してから、同行者に合流場所を伝えると安心です。戻る時間には余裕がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is best to check a route you can use both ways before telling your companion where to meet. Do you have plenty of time before you need to return?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このあと待ち合わせがあって、あまり余裕がありません。帰りの設備が使えなくなった場合は、どう案内されるかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の待ち合わせまで時間が少ないことを伝え、帰りの設備が使えなくなった場合の案内を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an appointment afterward, so I do not have much spare time. I am also concerned about what guidance I would receive if the equipment for the return journey became unavailable.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have little time before your next appointment and ask what guidance would be provided if the return equipment became unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運用が変わった時の案内は担当者に確認してください。階段以外の帰り方が確認できなければ、無理に上へ進まない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the person in charge about guidance when operations change. If you cannot confirm a way back other than stairs, it would be better not to push yourself to go up.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、往復の方法がわかるまではここで待ちます。同行者には、下で合流する可能性があると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往復の方法が分かるまで待ち、同行者には下で合流する可能性を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will wait here until I know how to get there and back. I will let my companion know we may need to meet downstairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait until you know how to travel both ways and tell your companion you may meet downstairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今いる場所の案内表示を写真で送ると、戻って来る時に探しやすくなります。確認した経路だけを使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Sending a photo of the sign showing where you are will make it easier to find you when they return. Please use only the route you have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在地を写真で送り、往復の経路と所要の目安を担当者に確認します。条件が合わなければ、今日は下で同行者を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地を写真で知らせ、往復の経路と所要時間を確認し、条件が合わなければ下で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will send a photo of my current location and ask the person in charge about the outward and return routes and approximate time needed. If the conditions do not work for me, I will wait downstairs for my companion today.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will send a photo of your current location, check the routes both ways and travel time, and wait downstairs if the conditions do not suit you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当者に確認する場所をご案内します。膝に無理のない方法をお選びください。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you where to ask the person in charge. Please choose an option that does not strain your knees. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。魚選びについて、どのようなお手伝いができますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you choose some fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で二人分の焼き魚を作りたいです。函館の売場でこの丸いままの魚が気になりましたが、料理はあまり得意ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の焼き魚を作りたいが料理に慣れていないと伝え、丸ごとの魚について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to make grilled fish for two at home. This whole fish caught my eye at the shop in Hakodate, but I am not very good at cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to make grilled fish for two but are not used to cooking, and ask about a whole fish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 丸ごと焼ける調理器具はありますか。魚の大きさと、家のグリルの幅を比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have cookware that can grill it whole? Let us compare the fish's size with the width of your grill at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グリルは小さくて、この魚は入りそうにありません。切り身にしてもらえれば使えるかと思うんですが、お願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家のグリルには魚が入りそうにないと説明し、切り身にしてもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My grill is small, and I do not think this fish will fit. I think I could use it if you cut it into portions. Could you do that?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the fish probably will not fit in your grill at home and ask whether it can be cut into portions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品の下処理に対応できるか確認します。切り身にしても骨が残ることがあります。骨を避けたい理由もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether we can prepare this product. Bones may remain even after it is cut into portions. Is there also a reason you want to avoid bones?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一緒に食べる人が小さい骨を取りにくいんです。骨がないと決めつけず、食べる前に確認できる形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一緒に食べる人が小骨を取りにくいと説明し、骨がないと思い込まず食べる前に確かめられる形を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The person eating with me finds it hard to remove small bones. I do not want to assume there are no bones; I would like it in a form that lets us check before eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your dining companion has difficulty removing small bones and ask for a form that allows checking before eating without assuming it is boneless. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、骨を確認しやすい大きさの切り身があるかも比べましょう。加工が難しければ、別の商品を選ぶことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us also compare whether we have portions in a size that makes bones easy to check. If processing is difficult, you will need to choose another product.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸魚にこだわりません。切り身を選ぶ場合、表示の一切れの重さではなく、二人で食べる量を見て相談してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 丸魚にはこだわらないと伝え、二人が食べる量に合う切り身を相談してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am not set on a whole fish. If I choose portions, may I ask about an amount for two people to eat rather than just the weight shown for one piece?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are not set on a whole fish and ask whether you can discuss portions that suit the amount two people will eat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。食べる量と調理器具に合うものを選びましょう。加熱の仕方や保存については、その商品の表示を確認してお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us choose something that suits your appetite and cookware. We will check this product's label for cooking and storage instructions and give them to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: グリルに入る切り身を二人分選びます。下処理ができる範囲と、残る骨、保存と加熱の案内を確認してから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: グリルに入る切り身を二人分選び、加工の範囲、残る骨、保存と加熱の案内を確認してから買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose two people's worth of portions that fit in my grill. I will buy after checking what preparation is possible, what bones remain, and the storage and cooking instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose portions for two that fit the grill and buy after checking the extent of processing, remaining bones, and storage and cooking instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず加工できるかと切り身の商品を確認します。ご自宅で扱いやすいものを一緒に選びましょう。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, I will check whether we can process it and what portioned fish we have. Let us choose something easy for you to handle at home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書道体験では、どのような作品を書いてみたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What sort of piece would you like to write during the calligraphy experience?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の名前を記念に書いて持ち帰りたいです。函館での体験なので、日本語の漢字に直して書けたらと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記念に自分の名前を書いて持ち帰りたいと伝え、漢字に変えて書けるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to write my name and take it home as a souvenir. Since this is an experience in Hakodate, I was hoping to convert it to Japanese kanji and write that.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to write your name to take home as a souvenir, and ask whether it can be converted to kanji. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音に合う漢字を選ぶことはできますが、名前の正式な訳になるわけではありません。意味も含めて相談したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can choose kanji that match its sounds, but that does not make it an official translation of your name. Would you like to discuss their meanings too?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 漢字なら正しい日本語の名前になると思っていました。意味を知らずに選ぶより、普段使っているカタカナの名前を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字にすれば正式な日本語の名前になると思っていたと説明し、普段使うカタカナの名前を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought using kanji would make it a proper Japanese name. Rather than choosing characters without knowing their meanings, I would like to write the katakana name I normally use.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought kanji would make an official Japanese name, and choose the katakana name you normally use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ではカタカナで練習しましょう。まずこの紙で筆の動きを試してください。墨の量は、線を見ながら調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us practice in katakana. First, try moving the brush on this paper. We will adjust the amount of ink while looking at the strokes.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書いてみたら線が広がって、隣の文字とくっつきました。筆に墨をつけすぎたんでしょうか。力の入れ方もわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 線が広がって隣の文字とくっついたと報告し、墨の量や筆に入れる力について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I tried writing, the strokes spread and joined the neighboring character. Did I put too much ink on the brush? I also do not know how much pressure to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that the strokes spread and joined the neighboring character, and ask about the amount of ink and pressure on the brush. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 墨の量、紙、筆の押し方が関係します。筆先を整えてから、一文字を大きめに書いてみましょう。名前全体は、間隔を決めてから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The ink quantity, paper, and how you press the brush all affect it. Let us shape the brush tip, then try writing one character fairly large. We will decide the spacing before writing your whole name.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一文字ずつ練習してから、名前の間隔を決めます。帰りに作品がこすれないようにしたいので、乾燥と持ち帰り方も先に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一文字ずつ練習してから名前の間隔を決めると伝え、乾燥と持ち帰り方も確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will practice one character at a time, then decide the spacing for my name. I want to prevent the piece from rubbing on the way home, so could I also check the drying and carrying arrangements in advance?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will practice individual characters before deciding the spacing for your name, and want to check drying and how to take it home too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。使う紙の乾き具合を見て、折らずに運べる方法があるか確認しましょう。乾いていない面を重ねないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us check how dry this paper is and whether there is a way to carry it without folding it. Please do not stack surfaces that have not dried.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 漢字への変更はせず、カタカナの名前で仕上げます。墨と間隔を練習して、乾いたことと持ち帰り方を確認してから荷物に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カタカナで仕上げ、墨の量と間隔を練習し、乾いたことと運び方を確認してから荷物に入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will finish my name in katakana without changing it to kanji. I will practice the ink amount and spacing, and check that it is dry and how to carry it before putting it in my luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will finish it in katakana, practice the ink amount and spacing, and check dryness and carrying arrangements before packing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、まず一文字の練習から始めましょう。できた作品を傷めずに持ち帰れるよう、最後も一緒に確認します。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us begin by practicing one character. We will also check together at the end so you can take your finished piece home without damaging it. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。携帯電話のことで、どのようなお困りごとですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What trouble are you having with your mobile phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 函館で使っている携帯の請求が高く感じます。家では無線LANを使い、外ではあまり動画を見ないので、小さいプランに変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家では無線LANを使い外では動画をあまり見ないと説明し、携帯の請求を抑えるため小さいプランを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mobile phone bill in Hakodate seems high. I use wireless LAN at home and do not watch many videos outside, so I would like to switch to a smaller plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you use wireless LAN at home and rarely watch videos outside, and ask about a smaller plan to reduce your mobile bill. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通信量と請求の内訳を分けて見てみましょう。明細に、通信料金以外の端末代や追加サービスはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at your data usage separately from the bill breakdown. Does the bill include device installments or additional services apart from communication charges?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端末の分割払いが書いてあります。通信会社を変えたら、この端末代もなくなると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明細に端末の分割払いがあり、通信会社を変えればその支払いもなくなると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It shows device installments. I thought those device payments would disappear too if I changed mobile carriers.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bill shows device installments and you thought changing carriers would also end those payments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通信契約と端末代の支払いは別に確認する必要があります。乗り換えた後も支払いが残るか、今の契約内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the service contract and device payments separately. Let us check your current contract to see whether payments will remain after switching.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今の会社に端末代の残額を確認します。ここでは、月額の広告だけでなく、割引が終わった後の負担も説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今の会社に端末代の残額を確認すると伝え、割引が終わった後の料金も説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask my current carrier about the outstanding device balance. Here, could you explain the cost after discounts end, as well as the advertised monthly price?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your current carrier about the remaining device balance, and request an explanation of charges after discounts end too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。比較する時は、割引中と終了後の通信料金、初期費用、残る端末代を分けましょう。電話をどれくらい使うかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. When comparing, let us separate the service charges during and after discounts, initial fees, and remaining device payments. We will also check how much you use voice calls.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場への連絡で電話は使います。データは少なくても通話料が増えるなら困るので、通話の条件も書面で比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場への電話も必要だと伝え、データ量だけでなく通話の条件も書面で比べたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I use calls to contact my workplace. It would be a problem if call charges increased even with less data, so I would like to compare the call conditions in writing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you also need to call your workplace and want to compare call conditions in writing, rather than data allowance alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。通話の対象や追加料金の条件も確認できる資料でご説明します。端末代の残額が不明な間は、合計の比較を確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will explain using materials that show which calls are covered and the conditions for additional charges. Until we know the remaining device balance, we cannot finalize a comparison of the totals.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は契約せず、資料を持ち帰ります。端末代の残額を確認して、通信料、通話料、初期費用を合わせて比べてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は契約せず資料を持ち帰り、端末代の残額と通信料、通話料、初期費用を合わせて比べてから決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not sign a contract today; I will take the materials home. I will check the remaining device balance and compare it together with data charges, call charges, and initial fees before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the materials home without signing today, and decide after comparing the remaining device balance, data charges, call charges, and initial fees together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。確認する項目を資料にまとめてご案内します。不明点が残る場合は、契約前にまたご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I will summarize the items to check in the materials and explain them. If anything remains unclear, please consult us again before signing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。交通系カードについて、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about your transit card?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 函館で移動中に、このカードで支払おうとしたら使えませんでした。残高が足りないなら、追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 移動中にカードで支払えなかったと説明し、残高不足ならチャージしたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: While traveling in Hakodate, I tried paying with this card, but it did not work. If the balance is insufficient, I would like to add money.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you could not pay with your card while traveling, and ask about topping it up if the balance is insufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残高不足とは限りません。どの交通機関で使おうとしましたか。表示された内容を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may not be an insufficient balance. Which transport service did you try to use it on? Do you remember what the display said?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示は覚えていません。前に使えた時の記録を見たら、別のカードで払っていました。このカードも同じように使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: エラー表示は覚えておらず、以前の支払いは別のカードだったと分かったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not remember the display. When I checked the record from when I could pay before, I had paid with a different card. I thought this card would work in the same way too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not remember the error display and discovered the previous payment was made with a different card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カードの種類と利用先を確認しましょう。カード同士で使える範囲が同じとは限りません。これからどこへ向かう予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the card type and where you tried to use it. Different cards do not necessarily have the same coverage. Where are you planning to go now?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この地図の行き先です。先にたくさんチャージするより、予定の路線で使えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で行き先を示し、多くチャージする前に予定の路線でカードが使えるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: To this destination on the map. Rather than adding a lot of money first, I want to check whether the card works on my planned route.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your destination on the map and say you want to check whether the card works on your planned route before adding a large amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。路線と支払い方法を確認してから、必要なチャージを考えましょう。カードが使えない場合の支払い方法も見ておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let us check the route and payment methods before considering any necessary top-up. We will also look at how to pay if the card cannot be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金もあります。使えない場合は現金で払いますが、乗る前にどこで運賃を確認できるか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金も持っていると伝え、カードが使えない場合の運賃を乗る前にどこで確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have cash too. I will pay cash if the card does not work, but could you tell me where I can check the fare before boarding?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have cash too and ask where to check the fare before boarding if the card cannot be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用する交通機関の運賃案内や窓口で確認しましょう。車内で慌てないよう、支払うタイミングも一緒に確認すると安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the transport service's fare information or ticket counter. It is also reassuring to check when to pay so you do not get flustered on board.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このカードの種類と予定の路線を確認し、使えなければ現金払いの運賃とタイミングを調べます。確認前にはチャージしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カードの種類と路線を確認し、使えなければ現金の運賃と支払いのタイミングを調べ、確認前にはチャージしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check this card's type and my planned route, and if it does not work, find out the cash fare and when to pay. I will not top it up before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the card type and route, find out the cash fare and payment timing if it cannot be used, and not top up before checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずカードの表示と地図を一緒に確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, let us check the card markings and map together. Thank you for consulting us. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。果物選びについて、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you choose some fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 函館の友人への手土産です。明日渡すつもりなので、ちょうど食べごろのものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日友人に渡す手土産を探していると伝え、食べごろの果物を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a gift for a friend in Hakodate. I plan to give it to them tomorrow, so I would like to choose fruit that is just ready to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for a gift to give your friend tomorrow and want fruit that is ready to eat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明日渡して、すぐ食べるご予定ですか。食べる日が変わるなら、それも考えて選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will they eat it straight away after you give it to them tomorrow? If the eating date may change, let us consider that when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今連絡が来て、友人は明日残業かもしれないそうです。渡せるのが翌日になる可能性があります。すぐ熟しそうなものは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の残業で渡せる日が一日遅れるかもしれないと説明し、すぐ熟しそうな果物を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I just got a message saying my friend might work overtime tomorrow. I may not be able to give it to them until the following day. I want to avoid fruit that looks likely to ripen very soon.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend's overtime may delay giving the gift by one day, and say you want to avoid fruit that will ripen very soon. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、商品の状態を確認して比べましょう。受け取る方は、切って食べる果物でも扱えそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check and compare the condition of the products. Would the recipient be able to handle fruit that needs cutting?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寮の部屋には包丁がないと言っていました。大きいものを一つより、手で扱えて少しずつ食べられるものの方がよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の部屋には包丁がないと説明し、手で扱えて少しずつ食べられる果物を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said they do not have a kitchen knife in their dorm room. Rather than one large fruit, something they can handle by hand and eat a little at a time seems better.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend has no kitchen knife in their room and ask for fruit they can handle by hand and eat a little at a time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうですね。扱い方と量を考え、少量の商品も比べましょう。品種によって保存方法が違うので、商品を決めてから表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let us consider preparation and quantity and compare smaller packages too. Storage methods differ by variety, so we will check the label after choosing a product.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、少量で二日後にも渡しやすい状態のものを相談したいです。保存の説明を覚えきれないので、表示を写真に撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二日後にも渡しやすい状態の少量の商品を相談し、保存表示を写真に撮ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I would like advice on a small amount in a condition suitable for giving in two days too. I cannot remember all the storage instructions, so may I photograph the label?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about a small quantity suitable for giving in two days and ask permission to photograph the storage label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身が選ぶ商品の表示を確認して、必要な情報を控えてください。写真にほかのお客様が写らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the label of the product you choose and note the information you need. Please make sure other customers do not appear in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が受け取れる日をもう一度確認し、少量で扱いやすいものを選びます。商品の保存表示も控えて、渡す時に一緒に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の受取日を再確認して扱いやすい少量の果物を選び、保存表示も控えて一緒に伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check again what day my friend can receive it and choose a small amount that is easy to handle. I will also note the product's storage instructions and explain them when handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will reconfirm the receiving date, choose a small amount of easy-to-handle fruit, and note and pass along the storage instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず受け取る日と、この商品の状態を確認しましょう。ご友人に合う手土産を選ぶお手伝いをします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, let us check the receiving date and this product's condition. I will help you choose a gift that suits your friend. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計の前に確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you. Is there anything you want to check before paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この明細に同じ料理が二回書かれています。函館の友人と二人で食べましたが、一回しか頼んでいない気がします。確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明細に同じ料理が二行あるが一度しか頼んだ記憶がないと説明し、注文を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This itemized bill lists the same dish twice. I ate with a friend from Hakodate, but I think we ordered it only once. Could you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the same dish appears on two lines of the bill but you remember ordering it only once, and ask to have the order checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文の記録を確認します。最初の注文の後に、追加で注文した方はいらっしゃいますか。同行の方にも確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the order record. Did anyone place an additional order after the first one? Could you check with your companion too?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人に聞いたら、私が席を外した時に追加したそうです。二回の注文で合っています。二重に入ったと決めつけてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人が自分の離席中に追加注文したと分かったことを伝え、二重計上だと思った誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked my friend, and they ordered more while I was away from the table. Two orders is correct. I jumped to the conclusion that it was entered twice by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you learned that your friend ordered more while you were away, and correct your misunderstanding that the bill was double-counted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認ありがとうございます。ではその二行は、追加分を含むものとして記録を照合します。ほかに気になる項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for checking. Then we will compare those two lines with the records as including the additional order. Are there any other items you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲み物は名前が短く書かれていて、どれが私の分かわかりません。友人と分担したいので、略称の意味を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲み物の略称では自分の注文が分からないと説明し、友人と費用を分担するため内訳を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The drink names are abbreviated, so I do not know which one is mine. I want to share the costs with my friend, so please explain the abbreviations.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the abbreviated drink names make it hard to identify your order, and ask about the breakdown so you can share costs with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この明細の「生」は生ビール一杯、「ウ」はウーロン茶一杯です。ご友人の追加注文と飲み物も合わせて確認しましょう。別会計にできるかは、レジで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this bill, 'nama' means one draft beer and 'u' means one oolong tea. Let us check your friend's additional order and the drinks together. I will ask at the register whether separate payments are possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別会計ができなければ、私がまとめて払って友人と後で精算します。まず飲み物の内訳がわかる明細を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別会計ができなければ自分がまとめて払い、友人と後で精算すると伝え、飲み物の内訳を先に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If separate payments are not possible, I will pay the whole bill and settle up with my friend later. First, I want to check an itemized bill that makes the drink breakdown clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will pay the whole bill and settle up with your friend later if separate payments are unavailable, and want to check the drink breakdown first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認しました。こちらでは別会計はできません。飲み物の略称を説明した明細をお渡ししますので、追加料理も含めた合計をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I checked. We cannot accept separate payments here. I will give you the itemized bill with the drink abbreviations explained, so please check the total including the additional dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追加の料理は友人が頼んだ分で、飲み物の略称も確認できました。私がまとめて払って、明細を使い友人と後で精算します。レシートもお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の追加料理と飲み物の略称を確認できたと伝え、自分がまとめて払って後で友人と精算するためレシートを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed that my friend ordered the additional dish and what the drink abbreviations mean. I will pay everything and use the itemized bill to settle up with my friend later. Please give me the receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have confirmed your friend's additional dish and the drink abbreviations, and request a receipt so you can pay together and settle up with your friend later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ご確認いただいてからお支払いを伺います。ご利用ありがとうございました。お帰りの際は、お忘れ物にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-HAKODATE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will take your payment after you have checked. Thank you for dining with us. Please be careful not to leave anything behind when you go.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。作業前に、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you want to check before work?

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯広のこの牧場で、牛の通路を掃除するよう言われました。牛がまだいるので、どこで待てばいいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 牛がまだいる通路を掃除するよう指示されたので、作業を始めるまでの待機場所を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to clean the cattle passageway at this farm in Obihiro. The cattle are still there, so please tell me where to wait.
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you were instructed to clean a passageway where cattle are still present, and ask where to wait until starting work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 牛の移動経路に入らず、担当者が指定する場所で待ちましょう。掃除する範囲は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Stay out of the cattle's movement route and wait where the person in charge specifies. Have you confirmed the area you are to clean?

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の通路だと思っていますが、扉を開ければ入れると思っていました。牛がこちらへ来る可能性もあるんですね。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 掃除するのは奥の通路だと思っており、扉を開ければ入れると考えていたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think it is the passageway at the back, but I thought I could enter by opening the gate. So the cattle could come this way too.
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you think you are to clean the passageway at the back and thought you could enter by opening the gate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扉は勝手に開けないでください。牛の移動と作業者の位置を確認してから扱います。誰から作業の指示を受けましたか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not open the gate without permission. We handle it after checking the cattle's movement and the workers' positions. Who gave you the work instructions?

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝の担当者です。名前はまだ覚えていませんが、作業票に印があります。その人に掃除の範囲と入るタイミングを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝の担当者から指示を受けたが名前はわからないので、作業票の印を見せて担当者と作業範囲、開始時点を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-06.translation: The person in charge this morning. I have not learned their name yet, but there is a mark on my work sheet. I want to check the cleaning area and when to enter with that person.
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you received instructions from the morning person in charge but do not know their name, and want to show the work-sheet mark to identify them and check the work area and start time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作業票を見せてください。担当者を確認します。道具を持って牛の近くへ進まず、待機場所で説明を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me the work sheet. I will identify the person in charge. Do not take your tools and approach the cattle; get the explanation at the waiting area.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一頭が通路の途中で止まっています。自分で追い立てず、場所を担当者に伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路の途中で止まっている牛を見つけたので、自分で追い立てず担当者に位置を知らせればよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-08.translation: One animal has stopped partway along the passageway. Should I tell the person in charge where it is instead of trying to drive it onward myself?
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you found a cow stopped partway along the passageway, and ask whether to report its position rather than drive it onward yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。牛の場所と、見えた様子だけを伝えてください。無理に近づかず、動物への接近方法は担当者の実演で確認します。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Report only where the animal is and what you observed. Do not force yourself to approach it; learn how to approach the animals from the person in charge's demonstration.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業票を見せて、止まっている牛の位置を伝えます。扉は開けず、範囲と開始の合図、立ち位置を教えてもらってから掃除します。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業票と牛の位置を担当者に示し、扉を開けずに待ち、作業範囲、開始の合図、立ち位置を確認してから掃除すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the work sheet and report where the stopped animal is. I will not open the gate, and will clean only after being shown the area, the signal to begin, and where to stand.
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the work sheet and animal's position to the person in charge, wait without opening the gate, and clean after checking the work area, start signal, and standing position. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当者を呼びますので、指定の待機場所でお待ちください。作業前に確認してくれて、ありがとうございます。引き続きよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-HKD-OBIHIRO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will call the person in charge, so please wait in the designated waiting area. Thank you for checking before work. Thank you for your continued cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。今日の畑の作業で、わからないことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you do not understand about today's field work?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯広のこの農場で、三番を担当すると聞きました。この畝から始めればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三番を担当するよう言われたので、今いる畝から作業を始めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to take charge of number three at this farm in Obihiro. Should I start with this row?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you were assigned number three and ask whether you may start work on the row where you are. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三番が区画番号か畝番号かを確認しましょう。指示を受けた時の図や作業票はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check whether three is the plot number or the row number. Do you have a diagram or work sheet from when you were given instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この図があります。三番区画と書いてありました。私は入口から三本目の畝だと思って、隣の区画に来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作業図の三番区画という指示を入口から三本目の畝だと勘違いし、隣の区画に来てしまったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have this diagram. It said plot three. I thought it meant the third row from the entrance and came to the neighboring plot by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook 'plot three' on the work diagram for the third row from the entrance and came to the neighboring plot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 始める前に気づけてよかったです。こちらの区画では機械作業の予定があります。道具を使ったり、作物に手をつけたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is good you noticed before starting. Machine work is scheduled for this plot. Have you used any tools or touched any crops?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。道具は持っていますが、機械の近くを通って戻ろうとしていました。安全に移動できる通路を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具は持っているがまだ作業しておらず、機械の近くを通って戻ろうとしていたので、安全な移動経路を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I have my tools, but I was about to go back past the machinery. Please tell me a safe passageway to take.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have tools but have not started work and were about to return past the machinery, and ask to be shown a safe route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械の進路を横切らず、担当者に移動の案内を確認しましょう。正しい区画に着いたら、作業範囲の境も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not cross the machinery's path; ask the person in charge for directions on moving. Once you reach the correct plot, check the boundaries of your work area too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図を持って担当者に聞きます。境の札が見えない所では、隣の畝まで続けず、どこで止めるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図を持って担当者に尋ね、境の札が見えない所でも隣の畝へ進まないよう、作業を止める位置を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take the diagram and ask the person in charge. Where I cannot see a boundary tag, I want to check where to stop rather than continuing into the neighboring row.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the person in charge with the diagram and check where to stop so you do not continue into the neighboring row even where the boundary tag is not visible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。区画の境と本日の作業範囲は、現地で示してもらってください。道具の扱いも説明を受けてから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Have someone show you the plot boundary and today's work area on site. Begin only after receiving an explanation of how to handle the tools too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三番区画へ安全な通路で移動し、境と止める位置を指してもらいます。道具の使い方を見てから、指定の範囲だけ作業します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な通路で三番区画へ移動し、境と作業を止める位置を示してもらい、道具の実演を見てから指定された範囲だけ作業すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a safe passageway to plot three and have the boundary and stopping point shown to me. After watching how to use the tools, I will work only within the specified area.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will move to plot three by a safe passageway, have the boundary and stopping point shown, and work only in the designated area after watching a tool demonstration. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず移動の案内を確認します。場所が曖昧なまま始めず、相談してくれてありがとうございます。引き続きよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, I will check the directions for moving. Thank you for consulting us rather than starting while unsure of the location. Thank you for your continued cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。道の駅で、どのようなものをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for at the roadside station?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰ってから料理に使う野菜を買いたいです。この二つは重さが同じなので、同じくらいの量が食べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料理用の野菜を買いたいので、同じ重さの二つの商品で食べられる量も同じくらいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy vegetables to cook after I get home. These two products weigh the same, so will they give me about the same amount to eat?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want vegetables for cooking and ask whether two products of the same weight provide roughly the same edible amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 皮や芯など、使わない部分も含む重さかを見ましょう。何を作る予定で、どんな調理ができますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check whether the weight includes unused parts such as peel and cores. What do you plan to make, and what cooking can you do?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鍋一つで煮る予定です。仕事の後なので、厚い皮をむいたり硬いものを切ったりする時間はあまり取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍋一つで煮る予定だが、仕事の後には皮をむいたり硬い野菜を切ったりする時間をあまり取れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to simmer everything in one pot. It will be after work, so I cannot spend much time peeling thick skins or cutting hard vegetables.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to cook in one pot but have little time after work for peeling or cutting hard vegetables. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理の手間も比べたいんですね。表示と商品の状態を見て、下準備が必要な部分を確認しましょう。買った後の保存場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You want to compare the preparation involved too. Let us look at the labels and condition of the products to check which parts need preparation. Do you have somewhere to store them after buying?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寮の小さい冷蔵庫だけです。大袋の方が得に見えますが、全部入らなければ余らせてしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保存場所は寮の小さい冷蔵庫だけなので、割安に見える大袋を買っても入りきらず余らせるのが心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only a small refrigerator at my dormitory. The large bag looks better value, but if it does not all fit, I think I will end up with leftovers I cannot use.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your only storage is a small dormitory refrigerator, so you worry a large bag that looks economical will not fit and will go to waste. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保管できる量を優先して、少量の商品も比べましょう。室温で置けるかは、野菜の種類や状態の案内を確認して判断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us prioritize an amount you can store and compare smaller products too. For whether something can be kept at room temperature, check the guidance for that vegetable's type and condition before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大袋にこだわらず、一度の料理で使える量にします。値段の表示は一袋か重さ当たりかも、比べる前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大袋ではなく一度の料理で使える量を選び、比較する前に価格が一袋当たりか重さ当たりか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not insist on a large bag; I will choose an amount for one cooking session. Before comparing, I also want to check whether the displayed price is per bag or by weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will choose an amount for one cooking session rather than a large bag, and want to check whether prices are per bag or by weight before comparing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。値段の単位、内容量、調理と保存の案内を分けて確認しましょう。見た目の価格だけで決めずに選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us check the price unit, quantity, and cooking and storage instructions separately. That lets you choose without relying only on the apparent price.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一回で使える量と下準備の少なさを優先します。価格の単位と保存表示を確認し、冷蔵庫に入らない量は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一回で使い切れる量と下準備の少なさを優先し、価格の単位と保存表示を確認して、冷蔵庫に入らない量は買わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prioritize an amount I can use at once and little preparation. I will check the price unit and storage label and will not buy more than fits in the refrigerator.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prioritize an amount you can use at once and minimal preparation, check the price unit and storage label, and not buy more than fits in the refrigerator. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。少量の候補から一緒に見ていきましょう。ご自宅で使い切れるものを選ぶお手伝いをします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us look together at the smaller options first. I will help you choose something you can use up at home. Thank you.
